_about: Which parts of the project the agent may touch. Checked by .agent/hooks/zone_guard.py before EVERY tool call. Paths are relative to the project root; a path ending in / means the whole folder. Locked zones can't be read, searched, listed recursively or edited until the USER unlocks them (! .agent/zone.sh unlock <zone>); every unlock ends with the session. Read-only zones can be read but not changed. Git pushes/merges/history rewrites and Agent settings files are hard-gated in zone_guard.py itself (not unlockable here). Change this file only with the user (it's in the 'harness' zone).

sealed.why: build output, old stuff, the public clone, third-party prop meshes, the scratch Python env - never useful to read

hardware.why: case, wiring and carrier board are finished (box closed 2026-10-22); facts the firmware needs are in CONTEXT.md and pinout.md

history.why: closed session-log volumes; the current state is in CONTEXT.md and the live docs/session-log.md

reference.why: fixed facts: pins and the licence

harness.why: the rules, their logs and their tests - the agent can't loosen its own guard or edit its own trace
